listenings.text: Hi, I'm Tom. Last month I was in Washington for two days. It was my first time in the city. On Saturday I walked around the National Mall. It is a very long park, with monuments and museums. The best part? The museums were free. I visited the Natural History Museum in the morning, and in the afternoon I booked a guided tour of the Capitol. The guide was very funny. On Sunday I wanted to see the Air and Space Museum, but it was very crowded, so I stayed only one hour. In the evening I walked to the Lincoln Memorial. The view of the city at night was beautiful.

Hello, my name is Priya. In June I was in Chicago for a marketing conference. The conference was three days long, and it was very busy. After the last day, I wanted to see the city. A colleague said: book the architecture tour on the river. So I booked it for the next morning. It was ninety minutes on a boat, and the guide talked about every building. I loved it. The buildings were so tall, and the view from the river was amazing. I stayed in a small hotel in a quiet neighborhood, so in the evening I walked around and tried the famous deep dish pizza. It was a lot of pizza for one person.
